items.name: Dogslicer
items.description: This short, curved, and crude makeshift blade often has holes drilled into it to reduce its weight. It's a favored weapon of goblins.

items.name: Composite Shortbow
items.description: This shortbow is made from horn, wood, and sinew laminated together to increase the power of its pull and the force of its projectile. Its compact size and power make it a favorite of mounted archers. Any time an ability is specifically restricted to a shortbow, it also applies to composite shortbows unless otherwise stated.

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

defensiveAbilities.name: Goblin Scuttle
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A goblin ally ends a move action adjacent to the goblin.

Effect The goblin Steps.

offensiveAbilities.name: Disorienting Shot
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect Gurlunk makes two Strikes against his hunted prey with his shortbow. If both hit the same creature, the creature succeed at a DC 21 Will Saving Throw save or become Off-Guard until the start of their next turn (or the start of Gurlunk's next turn on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Hunt Prey
offensiveAbilities.description: Gurlunk designates a single creature he can see or hear, and gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Seek and Track that prey. He can only have one creature so designated at a time, and if he selects a new hunted prey, the previous designation ends.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hunter's Edge
offensiveAbilities.description: Gurlunk deals an additional 1d8 precision damage the first time he hits his hunted prey in a round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Whistling Threat
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect Gurlunk whistles sharply at a Medium or larger animal or beast he can see within 30 feet, using his voice to dull the creature's wits and cause it to lower its defenses. The target must attempt a DC 21 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Frightened 1.

Failure The target is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The target is Frightened 3 and Slowed 1 for 1 round as it shakes in fear.
